name: Zacess Deep Contrast Light
description: Black on white with vivid deep colours, red focus outlines and navy frames, for low vision.
toml:
# the Zacess Deep Contrast Light theme as a profile, one of the ten starter profiles
# colours from the Zacess themes palette 0.12.1

spec_version = 1
name = "Zacess Deep Contrast Light"
id = "zacess-deep-contrast-light"
description = "Black on white with vivid deep colours, red focus outlines and navy frames, for low vision."
appearance = "light"

[needs]
reduce_motion = true
cursor_size = "standard"
focus_ring_width_px = 2

[needs.contrast]
text = 7.0
non_text = 3.0
overlay = 4.5
terminal = 7.0
terminal_dim = 4.5
highlight_distance = 0.08
colour_vision_distance = 0.04
tone_difference = 0.05

[needs.font]
family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"
fallback = "monospace"
size_pt = 14

[palette]
background = "#ffffff"
foreground = "#000000"
surface = "#ffffff"
surface_alt = "#ffffff"
muted = "#4d4d4d"
border = "#0f4a85"
accent = "#0f4a85"
accent_foreground = "#ffffff"
link = "#003df6"
focus_ring = "#b5200d"
cursor = "#000000"
cursor_text = "#ffffff"
selection_background = "#990098"
selection_foreground = "#ffffff"
selection_soft = "#ffbcfa"
line_highlight = "#c8debd"
error = "#aa0000"
# was #674100, which matched the error colour in tone and merged with it under simulated colour
# vision deficiencies; this burnt orange is the most colourful shade that keeps them apart at 7:1
warning = "#642600"
info = "#002ec2"

[palette.syntax]
keyword = "#002ec2"
control = "#950094"
function = "#824100"
type = "#003a39"
variable = "#000000"
parameter = "#000000"
property = "#2e0078"
string = "#870000"
number = "#a3005f"
comment = "#006108"
operator = "#000000"
tag = "#002ec2"
attribute = "#2e0078"
regex = "#a60049"
invalid = "#aa0000"
added = "#006108"
removed = "#730000"
changed = "#002ec2"

[palette.terminal]
ansi = [
    "#000000", "#ca0000", "#00892e", "#ad6500",
    "#0040ff", "#cd01cd", "#016e78", "#595959",
    "#404040", "#d14100", "#00884f", "#907300",
    "#0d00ff", "#db009a", "#0178c1", "#000000",
]
dim = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]

check.output:
pass profiles/zacess-deep-contrast-light.toml (Zacess Deep Contrast Light)
     224 pairs against text 7:1, non-text 3:1, overlay 4.5:1, terminal 7:1 and dim terminal 4.5:1, with paired colours 0.05 apart in tone and 0.04 under colour vision deficiencies
     tightest link #003df6 on background #ffffff: 7.00:1
